questions.q: Why was the mirror important to the Renaissance?
a: It encouraged people to look inward
It made glassblowing much cheaper
It was used to build telescopes
It replaced painted portraits
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the mirror did not cause the Renaissance but made self-reflection possible.

questions.q: What did the light bulb replace as a light source?
a: Candles made from whale oil
Gas lamps powered by coal
Oil lamps made from plants
Torches made of wood
questions.why: Lesson 2 says candles were made from spermaceti taken from sperm whales.

questions.q: How did flash photography lead to social change?
a: Photos of poor conditions led to a new law
It helped sailors navigate at night
It made feature films possible
It replaced the light bulb entirely
questions.why: Lesson 2 says Riis documented Five Points, and the images helped pass a law improving conditions.

questions.q: Why is Edison not the sole inventor of the light bulb?
a: About 20 people had similar prototypes
He stole the design from a rival
He only funded someone else's work
He never actually built one
questions.why: Lesson 3 says roughly 20 people produced similar concepts at almost the same time.

questions.q: How was Ada Lovelace's algorithm different from the light bulb?
a: It came from one person's poetic view of math
It solved an urgent global problem
It was developed by a large team
It had immediate commercial demand
questions.why: Lesson 3 says her work was not an urgent need but a personal blend of math and poetry.
